about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Heirloom Tomato Salad with Basil Oil
recipes.summary: Thick slices of ripe mixed tomatoes with a vivid basil oil and flaky salt.
steps: Blend the basil, oil, garlic and a pinch of salt until smooth and bright green.
Arrange the tomatoes on a platter and season with salt and pepper.
Drizzle with the vinegar and basil oil until well coated, then stand for 5 minutes.
notes: Use tomatoes at room temperature for the best flavour.

recipes.title: Tomato and Watermelon Salad with Mint
recipes.summary: Juicy tomato and watermelon cubes with mint, red onion and salty feta.
steps: Combine the tomato, watermelon and onion in a large bowl.
Whisk the oil, lime juice and pepper and pour over.
Toss gently until just coated, then scatter with feta and mint.
notes: Serve straight away, as the watermelon releases juice if it stands.

recipes.title: Roast Cherry Tomato Pasta Sauce
recipes.summary: Cherry tomatoes roasted until jammy with garlic, then crushed into a sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and line a large tray with baking paper.
Toss the tomatoes and garlic with the oil, sugar, salt and pepper on the tray.
Roast for 30 minutes, until the tomatoes burst and the edges caramelise.
Squeeze the garlic from its skins and crush everything with a fork until chunky, then fold through the basil.
notes: Spoon over cooked pasta or serve on toast. Freezes for 3 months.

recipes.title: Ripe Tomato and Chilli Table Salsa
recipes.summary: A chunky fresh salsa with lime, coriander and a little chilli for corn chips or tacos.
steps: Combine the tomato, onion, chilli and coriander in a bowl.
Stir through the lime juice, oil and salt until evenly mixed.
Rest for 10 minutes so the flavours mingle, then drain off any excess liquid.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

recipes.title: Panzanella with Ripe Tomato and Cucumber
recipes.summary: Torn crusty bread soaks up tomato juice and a sharp vinaigrette.
steps: Heat the oven to 200C. Toss the bread with 2 tbsp oil and bake for 10 minutes, until crisp and golden.
Salt the tomatoes in a large bowl and stand for 10 minutes to draw out their juices.
Add the vinegar, remaining oil, cucumber and onion and toss until combined.
Fold through the warm bread and basil, then rest for 10 minutes, until the bread softens slightly at the edges.
notes: Best eaten within 2 hours of mixing.

recipes.title: Burst Tomato and Ricotta Toast
recipes.summary: Blistered cherry tomatoes spooned over whipped ricotta on crisp toast.
steps: Heat the oil in a frying pan over high heat and cook the tomatoes for 5 minutes, until they blister and burst.
Stir the ricotta with the lemon zest and a pinch of salt.
Toast the sourdough until golden and crisp.
Spread the ricotta over the sourdough until thickly covered, then spoon over the tomatoes and finish with balsamic, basil and pepper.
notes: Add a fried egg on top for a bigger brunch.

recipes.title: Slow Roasted Tomato Sauce for Freezing
recipes.summary: Halved tomatoes roasted slowly with garlic and thyme, then puréed into a sweet, deep sauce.
steps: Heat the oven to 160C and line two large trays with baking paper.
Place the tomatoes cut-side up on two trays with the onion and garlic, drizzle with oil and season.
Roast for 90 minutes, until the tomatoes are soft, collapsed and caramelised at the edges.
Discard the thyme stalks and blend until smooth.
Cool completely, then portion into containers.
notes: Freezes for up to 4 months. Taste and add sugar if the tomatoes were tart.

recipes.title: Summer Tomato and Corn Chowder
recipes.summary: Sweet corn and ripe tomatoes in a lightly creamy chowder.
steps: Warm the oil in a large pot and cook the onion for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the potato, corn, tomato and stock and simmer for 20 minutes, until the potato is tender.
Blend about a third of the soup, then stir it back in with the milk and heat until steaming.
Season and scatter with basil.
notes: Do not boil after adding the milk.

recipes.title: Grilled Pear and Rocket Salad with Goat's Cheese
recipes.summary: Charred pear halves with peppery rocket, creamy goat's cheese and toasted almonds.
steps: Brush the pears with the oil and grill cut-side down in a hot pan for 4 minutes, until charred and softening.
Toast the almonds in a dry pan for 2 minutes, until golden.
Whisk the vinegar, extra oil and pepper, and toss with the rocket.
Slice the pears onto the rocket and finish with goat's cheese and almonds.
notes: Use firm, just-ripe pears so they hold their shape.

recipes.title: Honeyed Yoghurt Cups with Mango and Toasted Almonds
recipes.summary: Fresh mango with thick yoghurt, toasted almonds and a drizzle of honey.
steps: Stir the vanilla through the yoghurt until smooth.
Divide among two bowls and top with the mango slices.
Scatter over the almonds and finish with honey and cinnamon.
notes: Toast the almonds in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden for extra flavour.

recipes.title: Mango, Cucumber and Rocket Salad with Lime Dressing
recipes.summary: Fresh mango with cucumber, rocket and a zesty lime dressing.
steps: Whisk the oil, lime juice, honey and seasoning in a large bowl.
Add the cucumber and rocket and toss until lightly coated.
Fold in the mango and scatter with walnuts.
notes: Slice the mango cheeks off the stone and cube the flesh.

recipes.title: Spiced Pear Chutney
recipes.summary: A tangy, spiced pear chutney that keeps for weeks in the fridge.
steps: Combine all of the ingredients in a saucepan over medium heat.
Cook for 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until the pears soften and the chutney is thick and glossy.
Spoon into a clean jar while hot.
Cool and refrigerate once sealed.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 3 weeks. Serve with cheese, curries or cold meats.

recipes.title: Crisp Pear and Chilli Salsa for Barbecued Fish
recipes.summary: A sweet, tangy salsa of pear, lime and chilli to spoon over barbecued fish.
steps: Combine the pear, capsicum, onion, chilli and coriander in a bowl.
Add the lime juice, oil and salt and stir until evenly mixed.
Rest for 10 minutes, until the juices pool and the flavours come together.
notes: Best on the day it is made. Delicious with grilled barramundi or prawns.

recipes.title: Roast Pumpkin and Sage Salad with Pepitas
recipes.summary: Caramelised pumpkin with crisp sage, pepitas and a tangy dressing over rocket.
steps: Heat the oven to 210C and line a large tray with baking paper.
Toss the pumpkin with 2 tbsp oil and seasoning and roast for 25 minutes, until golden and tender.
Add the sage and pepitas to the tray for the last 4 minutes, until crisp.
Whisk the vinegar, mustard, honey and remaining oil and toss through the rocket.
Top with the pumpkin, sage and pepitas.
notes: Serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Spiced Pumpkin Soup with Coconut Cream
recipes.summary: Pumpkin with curry spices, blended smooth and finished with coconut cream.
steps: Warm the oil in a pot and cook the onion for 5 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the pumpkin and stock and simmer for 25 minutes, until the pumpkin is very tender.
Blend until smooth and stir through most of the coconut cream.
Season and serve with a swirl of coconut cream and coriander.
notes: Freezes well without the coconut cream swirl.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Spice Overnight Oats
recipes.summary: Creamy oats with pumpkin purée, cinnamon and maple, prepared the night before.
steps: Stir the oats, milk, pumpkin, yoghurt, maple syrup and spices in a bowl until smooth.
Divide into two jars and cover.
Refrigerate overnight, until thick and creamy, then top with pecans.
notes: Soaking time is not counted in the prep time. Keeps for 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Creamy Mushroom and Thyme Soup
recipes.summary: Earthy mushrooms and thyme blended with a splash of cream.
steps: Melt the butter in a large pot and cook the onion for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 10 minutes, until deeply golden and their liquid has evaporated, adding the garlic and thyme for the last minute.
Pour in the stock and simmer for 10 minutes, until the flavours meld.
Blend until smooth, stir in the cream and season.
notes: Do not boil after adding the cream. Keep a few cooked slices aside for garnish if you like.

recipes.title: Garlic Field Mushrooms Piled on Sourdough Slices
recipes.summary: Golden mushrooms with garlic, thyme and a splash of lemon piled onto thick toast.
steps: Melt half the butter in a large frying pan over high heat and cook the mushrooms in two batches for 5 minutes, until golden and any liquid has evaporated.
Return all the mushrooms, add the remaining butter, garlic and thyme and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in the lemon juice and season.
Toast the sourdough until golden and spoon the mushrooms over, finishing with parsley.
notes: Do not overcrowd the pan, or the mushrooms will steam instead of brown.

recipes.title: Barley-Thickened Winter Mushroom Soup
recipes.summary: A hearty soup of mushrooms, pearl barley and dill.
steps: Warm the oil in a pot and cook the onion and carrot for 6 minutes, until soft.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 8 minutes, until browned, then add the garlic for 1 minute.
Add the barley, stock and bay leaves and simmer for 35 minutes, until the barley is tender.
Stir through the dill and lemon juice and season.
notes: Barley thickens on standing, so add water when reheating.
Food safety: Reheat leftovers until steaming hot right through.

recipes.title: Roast Pumpkin Hummus
recipes.summary: Hummus with roasted pumpkin for a sweet, earthy dip.
steps: Heat the oven to 200C and roast the pumpkin with 1 tbsp oil for 30 minutes, until very tender and caramelised.
Blend the pumpkin with the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and salt until smooth.
Add the remaining oil and 2 tbsp cold water until silky.
Spoon into a bowl and drizzle with oil.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 4 days.

recipes.title: Marinated Mushroom Salad
recipes.summary: Lightly cooked mushrooms in a lemon and herb dressing, served at room temperature.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a frying pan and cook the mushrooms for 5 minutes, until golden and just tender.
Toss with the remaining oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, parsley and seasoning while warm.
Cool to room temperature, until the mushrooms soak up the dressing.
Serve over the rocket, tossing until just coated.
notes: Marinating time is not counted. Keeps in the fridge for 2 days.

recipes.title: Mushroom and Spinach Breakfast Hash
recipes.summary: Crisp potatoes tossed with mushrooms, spinach and a poached egg.
steps: Boil the potatoes for 6 minutes, until just tender, then drain and dry well.
Heat the oil in a large pan and fry the potatoes for 8 minutes, until golden and crisp.
Add the onion and mushrooms and cook for 5 minutes, until browned, then fold in the paprika and spinach until wilted.
Poach the eggs in gently simmering water for 3 minutes, until the whites are set, and place on top.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; cook the yolks through for anyone vulnerable.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Wedges with Tahini Yoghurt
recipes.summary: Roasted pumpkin with a cooling tahini yoghurt and a sprinkle of za'atar.
steps: Heat the oven to 210C and line a large tray with baking paper.
Toss the pumpkin with the oil, cumin and salt and roast for 35 minutes, until tender and charred at the edges.
Stir the yoghurt, tahini, lemon juice and a pinch of salt until smooth.
Spread the yoghurt on a platter, top with pumpkin, then sprinkle with za'atar and parsley.
notes: Add a little water if the yoghurt is too thick.

recipes.title: Onion and Mushroom Gravy for Roasts
recipes.summary: A rich vegetarian gravy of browned mushrooms and soy, good with roasts, mash or pies.
steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan and cook the onion for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the mushrooms and cook for 8 minutes, until deep brown and dry.
Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute, then whisk in the stock gradually.
Add the soy sauce and thyme and simmer for 8 minutes, until glossy and thick enough to coat a spoon.
notes: Strain for a smoother gravy if you like.

recipes.title: Curried Pumpkin and Chickpea Soup in Coconut Broth
recipes.summary: A soupy, mildly spiced bowl of pumpkin and chickpeas in a coconut broth.
steps: Warm the oil in a large pot and cook the onion for 5 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic, ginger and curry powder for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the pumpkin, chickpeas, coconut milk and stock and simmer for 25 minutes, until the pumpkin is tender.
Stir through the spinach until wilted and finish with lime juice and salt.
notes: Mash some of the pumpkin into the broth for a thicker texture.
